meta.name: glycoengineering
meta.description: Analyze and engineer protein glycosylation. Scan sequences for N-glycosylation sequons (N-X-S/T), predict O-glycosylation hotspots, and access curated glycoengineering tools (NetOGlyc, GlycoShield, GlycoWorkbench). For glycoprotein engineering, therapeutic antibody optimization, and vaccine design.

copy.tagline: 分析蛋白质糖基化位点,辅助抗体与疫苗设计
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在做治疗性抗体或疫苗的糖基化设计。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze protein glycosylation sites to support antibody and vaccine design.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you engineer glycosylation for therapeutic antibodies or vaccines.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude能扫描蛋白质序列，找出N-糖基化位点（N-X-S/T），预测O-糖基化热点，给出消除或添加糖基化位点的序列修改建议，并指引使用NetOGlyc等外部糖基化工具。
howto.when: 当你要求分析或改造蛋白质的糖基化模式，例如优化抗体、设计疫苗抗原、提高蛋白质稳定性时触发。

say.text: 帮我扫描这段蛋白序列的N-糖基化位点
say.note: Claude会列出所有N-X-S/T位点及位置

say.text: 预测这个蛋白的O-糖基化热点在哪里
say.note: Claude会给出S/T富集区域的热点位置

say.text: 如何通过突变去掉这个蛋白第120位的糖基化？
say.note: Claude会建议替换氨基酸并输出新序列

howto.what_en: With this skill, Claude can scan protein sequences for N-glycosylation sequons (N-X-S/T), predict O-glycosylation hotspots, suggest sequence mutations to remove or add glycosylation sites, and point to external tools like NetOGlyc.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to analyze or engineer protein glycosylation, e.g., optimize antibodies, design vaccine antigens, or improve protein stability.

say_en.text: Scan this protein sequence for N-glycosylation sites.
say_en.note: Claude will list all N-X-S/T sequons with positions.

say_en.text: Predict O-glycosylation hotspots in this protein.
How can I remove the glycosylation at position 120 by mutation?
say_en.note: Claude will suggest an amino acid substitution and output the new sequence.
